abilities.name: Human Storage
abilities.text: The user creates a pocket dimension where they can store anything they want. In there, there's infinite space. They spit out what the user needs on demand. A limitation is he can't enter it physically himself.

info: He likes to create weapons from things/people he's defeated.
He's a contracted merc for Fal-125.
The red on his eye is a tumor.

abilities.name: Poison Nuke
abilities.text: + Domain Expansion: the Nuke Field gives a 100% hit success and no way to escape.

info: Fal-125's attempt to create new life with old dinosaur DNA mixed with living entities, to create a new weapon. It sort of worked, leading to this.
Drawn in three sizes, growing from small to huge.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Spike
abilities.text: When hit with something, adrenaline immediately kicks in, increasing speed and damage massively.

abilities.name: Sound Spikes
abilities.text: It can launch huge shock waves from its body, and can increase its power by using an (easily replaceable) spike. It can also use the spikes as melee weapons.

abilities.name: Smiling Glitch
abilities.text: Once you are targeted by it, your vision will blur till you pass out. Usually he grabs you, then drowns you or slits your throat. A smiley appears randomly close to the area of the murder.

unclear: The ability name looks like "Smiling Glitch"; the Character Book has "Smiling Blight".

abilities.name: Forced Fusion
abilities.text: Forces things together to make something new.
